parameters.question: Compare two CRISPR gRNA design tables for human FOXP3 (20nt guide + NGG PAM, both strands, GC 20-80%, no runs of 4+ identical nucleotides). Align rows on the (target_sequence, pam_sequence) pair: every target_sequence in one file must appear in the other with the same pam_sequence, with no extra or missing pairs. Row order, column order, and additional columns (e.g., strand, position, GC content) may differ and must not cause a mismatch; treat sequence comparisons as case-insensitive.
